# Bite More

Bite More serves halal Italian-American pasta, burgers, wings and more in Georgia. Official menu availability and prices are shown in each location’s ordering storefront. Delivery coverage and fees depend on the exact checkout address.

## Restaurants
- [Buckhead](https://bitemore.us/buckhead): 3150 Roswell Rd NW, Suite A1, Atlanta, GA 30305; (470) 514-8473.
- [Duluth](https://bitemore.us/duluth): 2148 Duluth Hwy 120, Suite 117, Duluth, GA 30097; (943) 296-4518.
